spec.title: Average temperature by host
spec.description: Temperature per sensor over time. Thresholds: 70 °C warning, 85 °C critical.

spec.title: Hottest sensors
spec.description: Sensors with the highest current temperature.

spec.expr: 100 * count(count by (chip) (node_hwmon_temp_alarm{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"} > 0)) / count(count by (chip) (node_hwmon_chip_names{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})) or vector(0)

label_replace((count(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "temperature", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_fan_rpm{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"} > 0)), "kind", "fan", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_power_average_watt{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "power", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_in_volts{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "voltage", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_curr_amps{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "current", "__name__", ".*")

label_replace((count(node_hwmon_temp_alarm{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "temperature", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_fan_alarm{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "fan", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_in_alarm{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "voltage", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace((count(node_hwmon_intrusion_alarm{mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", chip=~"$chip"})), "kind", "intrusion", "__name__", ".*")
